translations.web: “ ‘Thus you shall separate the children of Israel from their uncleanness, so they will not die in their uncleanness when they defile my tabernacle that is among them.’ ”
translations.bsb: You must keep the children of Israel separate from their uncleanness, so that they do not die by defiling My tabernacle, which is among them.
